project_type: Serverless EdTech platform - pnpm monorepo with turborepo
build_system: pnpm workspaces + turborepo; individual packages use tsc, Next.js 14 (App Router) for web, Serverless Framework for API
test_framework: vitest for unit tests, Playwright for E2E (6 spec files with fixtures and helpers)
verification_instructions: 1) pnpm build to compile all packages, 2) pnpm test for unit tests, 3) For E2E: start mock server then run playwright test in tests/ directory
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. No AWS services available locally. Playwright tests require a running web server. Next.js app expects full server for SSR.
key_patterns: DI pattern in API handlers (createRegisterHandler), multi-tenant isolation via middleware, DPDP consent lifecycle, AES-256-GCM encryption for PII, HMAC-SHA256 signed OAuth state
directory_structure: apps/web (Next.js 14 App Router), apps/api (Lambda handlers), packages/shared (types, DPI, encryption), packages/ui (React component library), packages/ai (AI engine with adaptive learning, tutor, content generation, teacher copilot), infrastructure/ (8 AWS CDK stacks), tests/ (Playwright E2E with 6 spec files)
